pure-announcement.rationale: It is an editorial roundup of tool categories across the AI SDLC, not a launch, release note, or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: The nearest concepts cover MCP governance, SIEM visibility, and the Agent Skills format, none of which covers this piece's central 'round out your AI coding stack beyond generation' survey.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Every statistic is attributed and linked to a named survey or report (Sonar, Atlassian, CodeRabbit, Snyk, Qodo, DX), so the claims are checkable.

durability.rationale: The piece leans on 2025-2026 survey percentages (96% distrust, 89% incident rates, 3.6 hours saved) and current vendor rosters — exactly the adoption-snapshot content that dates within a year, even though the generic advice underneath survives.

actionability.rationale: It only describes the landscape — naming categories and vendors to 'review' (mirrord, Signadot, SAST, SCA, AI gateways) with vendor-executive quotes — and gives no mechanism a reader could build or decide from directly.

atomicity.rationale: It bundles five separable recommendations (test environments, code validation, security testing, observability, reusable skills), none developed past a few paragraphs of quotes, so there is no single core idea to state.
